messages:
alex: quick question — I'm renaming services/token-router/config/config.yaml -> runtime.yaml in a small cleanup PR. Who needs to approve this given our CODEOWNERS?

mira: if that path is covered by CODEOWNERS with a services/* rule owned by @eng-platform, someone from eng-platform should sign off. pinging @sam and @mira.

sam: I can take it. Quick check — is this strictly a filename rename (git mv) with no schema/behavior change? If yes i'm fine to approve as long as tests are green. add a note in the PR description. :+1:

alex: yes, just `git mv config.yaml runtime.yaml` and updated references in the repo. no logic changes. added PR body: "no functional change, rename only" and included `git diff --name-only` output.

jordan: fwiw infra doesn't need to approve unless the config is consumed by infra infra-systems (k8s manifests, helm values). token-router runtime config is app-local so infra not required.

codeowners-bot: auto-assigned reviewers: @eng-platform (services/*), @infra (ops/*) — please confirm.

mira: can you paste the CODEOWNERS snippet you think applies? just to be sure.

alex: snippet: ```/services/* @eng-platform /ops/* @infra``` — file lives under `/services/token-router/config/runtime.yaml` now.

sam: that matches. i'm reviewing now. if PR only renames files i'll approve.

ci-bot: CI: run all checks — build succeeded, unit tests passed (12/12), lint OK.

sam: approved — leaving a review now.

alex: thanks! will merge once the required approvals are present, merging after 10m if no objections.

mira: no objections from eng-platform. go ahead. :rocket:

alex: merged and deleted branch. thanks everyone.
